as_told.title: AUTEC weapons training facility with underwater cables in the Bahamas

plain: There are, Michels says, "tons of rumors" about a site in the Bahamas near Nassau that he calls ATIC, short for a weapons training facility known as AUTEC. He tells this himself, without naming a source, and in another episode adds that the facility has underwater cables that nobody knows the destination of. He brings it up because a hidden military site under the sea would be a natural place for stories of craft that travel underwater.
